rules.resourceAuthority: SSH destinations and user resource paths come only from user messages.
rules.execution: Commands invoke native interfaces in endpoint-specific private task workspaces.
rules.sourceDiscovery: Bundle resources are immutable; official retrieval is anonymous, read-only, allowlisted, size-bounded, and digest-recorded.
rules.completion: The Agent writes quantization/report.json and returns user-facing artifact paths.

tools.name: remote_shell
tools.description: Run one synchronous Bash command on an exact user-declared x86 or RDK SSH destination. Each destination uses a private task workspace for relative paths; user-declared absolute input paths remain readable according to endpoint permissions. Bash starts with set -e -o pipefail; use set +e only around an optional probe whose nonzero status you will inspect. Commands and descendants are terminated at timeoutSeconds. Use 30-60 seconds for probes and explicit longer limits only for foreground conversion, evaluation, or performance. Keep scripts and generated files in separate calls and each command comfortably below the 16384-character schema limit. Never retry a hanging command unchanged. The result contains auditId, exitCode, bounded stdout/stderr, and truncation flags.

tools.name: source_fetch
tools.description: Read one immutable bundle:// resource or one anonymous official HTTPS source document. Bundle resources contain the shared Hobot Code quantization prompt, knowledge, templates, helper contracts, and source registry. Official retrieval is GET-only, allowlisted, size-bounded, and digest-recorded. This tool returns evidence and never decides model semantics.

tools.name: file_copy
tools.description: Copy one regular file between two different user-declared SSH endpoints. Paths are relative to each endpoint's private task workspace; absolute paths, traversal, directories, and globs are rejected. expectedSha256 is checked at source and destination. Create one archive with remote_shell before transferring a directory or file set.
